summary.name: DeepMind Blog
summary.one_liner: The news blog of Google DeepMind, listing its recent AI research announcements and project updates.
use_cases: Keeping up with Google DeepMind research announcements
Reading about AI applied to science and genomics
Learning about AI safety and responsibility work
summary.what_it_does: The page is the news index for Google DeepMind's blog. It lists dated posts, each with a title, month and category tag (Science or Responsibility & Safety). Visible headlines from September and October 2026 cover antimicrobial peptide search with Google Antigravity, a fine-tuned scam-detection model built with the Singapore Government, private AI compute with server-side memory, the AlphaGenome Atlas for predicting DNA letter changes, and WeatherNext 3 for global weather. The page text contains only headlines and tags, so the articles' details are not visible here.
notable: Covers both science research and responsibility and safety work from Google DeepMind
Listed as a free educational resource in the awesome-ai-tools collection
Recent posts include AlphaGenome Atlas and WeatherNext 3
caveats: Page text shows only headlines and category tags, not full article content
Listing is a news index, not a software tool
